correctness.rationale: The proof combines exact mod-8 section congruences with a normalized 9-dimensional dyadic recurrence. A verified degree-nine annihilating identity propagates the required matrix integrality and parity pattern for all dyadic depths; Lucas and Legendre/Kummer then convert the block formulas into the stated binomial valuation identity. Exact-integer verification checks the finite matrix bases, recurrence parity condition, and all coefficients through n=100000.

originality.rationale: Searches of exact and synonymous tenth-power Thue--Morse valuation formulations found no matching theorem. The closest recent results cover m=5 and m=9, the families m=2^r and m=3*2^r (r>=2), and the special case m=6; m=10 is outside those stated families. Originality remains to the best of our knowledge because the full text of the very recent arXiv:2609.16966 was not inspected, leaving residual risk of incidental unadvertised tenth-power material.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a closed exact valuation formula for an exponent immediately outside the newly solved families, identifies a sharp two-unit exceptional correction on one residue class modulo eight, and proves nonvanishing of every tenth-power coefficient.
